nodes.description: Public state variable holding the external StakingContract interface instance at a fixed address, used as the target of the external call.
External view function balanceOf(address owner) that returns the number of deposits for an account by querying an external staking contract.
External call stakingContract.depositsOf(owner) to an untrusted contract whose return value is blindly trusted for array length.
Address parameter owner of balanceOf, forwarded directly into the external depositsOf call.
Named return value balance that receives the length of the external call result.

edges.reason: The parameter owner is passed without validation into the external depositsOf call.
The owner parameter is the input consumed by the balanceOf function logic.
The state variable stakingContract is the call target used by the external depositsOf invocation.
Execution of balanceOf unconditionally triggers the external depositsOf call.
The length of the externally returned array is assigned to the return variable balance.

normalization_plan.reason: owner is a non-core parameter consumed directly by balanceOf, so it collapses into the function node.
balance is the non-core named return value of balanceOf and carries no independent state, so it merges into the function node.
